hooks.name: Review public demo safety
hooks.description: Remind Kiro to check the local-only and exact-evidence requirements after public demo files change.

action.prompt: Review the changed public demo file against .kiro/specs/scope-change-review/requirements.md. Check that pasted rule text stays local, is rendered as text rather than HTML, every extracted candidate has exact source-line evidence, and no target requests or external dependencies were added. Report issues; do not make unrelated edits.
